title: Control group ordering
description: Top chrome controls must be regrouped in order: Utility(Hidden) | Scope | State | People with subtle separators.
resolution: Accept exact group order and separator placement as specified.
resolution_rationale: Pure presentation regrouping with no behavior impact; deterministic order reduces UI ambiguity.

title: People default label
description: When no person is selected, people control label should render as 'People: All'.
resolution: Set idle people label to 'People: All'.
resolution_rationale: Explicit idle-state label improves clarity without changing behavior semantics.

title: Visual emphasis hierarchy
description: Inactive groups/pills should be lower emphasis while active pills have stronger emphasis.
resolution: Use subdued inactive styles and stronger active styles per existing theme palette.
resolution_rationale: Consistent emphasis hierarchy improves scanability while preserving interaction behavior.

title: Spacing and separators
description: Inter-group spacing should be larger than intra-group spacing, with subtle vertical separators between groups.
resolution: Apply larger group gaps and low-contrast vertical separators.
resolution_rationale: Provides visual grouping clarity with minimal risk and no functional changes.

title: No behavior drift guarantee
description: Grouping patch must not alter scope/state/people/hidden behavior or composition semantics.
resolution: Treat all filter logic as immutable for this patch; only UI grouping and idle copy are changed.
resolution_rationale: Prevents unintended behavior drift and keeps this patch safely scoped.

title: Scope slider placement
description: When Center or Periphery is active, the existing scope slider must render within the Scope block grouping.
resolution: Keep slider colocated with All/Center/Periphery controls inside the Scope group.
resolution_rationale: Maintains semantic grouping and avoids confusion from detached scope sensitivity control.
